name: Voxel Plane Intersection via Vertex Weights
definition: A brute force method to rasterize triangles into voxels by calculating the Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) of the triangle to define a sublist of candidate voxels, then determining which of those voxels are intersected by the triangle plane using edge tangent planes.
summary: Voxel Plane Intersection via Vertex Weights is a parallelizable mesh-to-voxel rasterization method that uses discrete vertex-weight summation instead of continuous geometric tests to identify intersected voxels.
